description: Source code for the class ColumnarBatchRow, which provides a row view over an array of ColumnVector objects in Apache Spark's SQL vectorized processing module.

classes.name: ColumnarBatchRow
classes.description: A class that wraps an array of ColumnVector objects to provide a row-oriented view for Spark SQL vectorized processing.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the current row, copying each field based on its data type.
